body:
Following the steps to reproduce in #3038:

1. Create a tagged preauthkey: `headscale preauthkeys create --tags tag:some`
2. Register: `tailscale up --login-server=https://headscale.example.com --auth-key hskey-auth-…`
3. Create a headscale user: `headscale user create alice`
4. Force reauth: `tailscale up --login-server=https://headscale.example.com --advertise-tags= --force-reauth`
5. Crash: `headscale nodes register --user alice --key …`

yields another crash:
